video_title: Kirk Cousins Returns to Minnesota. Can He SAVE Justin Jefferson?

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Minnesota's defense is overrated due to Brian Flores' scheme
quotes.excerpt: The defense is overhyped based on Brian Flores, right? The defense is just overhyped.
quotes.quote: Looking at Minnesota, as I said a couple weeks ago, they were not real. They got nice defense, some nice defense. The defense is overhyped based on Brian Flores, right? The defense is just overhyped. When you run up against a real offense, that defense is yet to contain them.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Buffalo Bills' offense is limited to Josh Allen and the running back
quotes.excerpt: The Buffalo Bills are a two-man show. They got basically cooked the running back and Josh Allen.
quotes.quote: The Buffalo Bills are a two-man show. They got basically cooked the running back and Josh Allen. And that's pretty much, I mean you can throw DJ Moore and some other guys in there, I don't want to be disrespectful to them, but you're not dealing with a full arsenal across the board of 11 players on the offensive side of the ball that's going to be work.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Jefferson's frustration is understandable given the lack of quality targets
quotes.excerpt: You're going to be frustrated because what happens is the homies are calling you, your homeboy calling you.
quotes.quote: You're going to be frustrated because what happens is the homies are calling you, your homeboy calling you, your girlfriend calling you, your kids, if you got kids, they're asking you, you just get going to the 7-Eleven, somebody's asking you what's going. It's always something, constant. And it's going to be your fault because we're paying you all the money. Now you just got to figure out how to catch the football. But I can't catch a football when you're dribbling at my feet, two yards in front of me. You're throwing it, I can jump pretty high, but damn, that's 12 feet. I can't go get that. But people out there don't really care, they don't really understand. For me and Justin Jefferson, for what I would tell him is you just keep doing what you're doing. Don't get frustrated because the cameras are going to pan to you anyway. And the moment that you look distraught on the sideline, they're going to form their opinions because that's what it is, it's an opinionated business. That just got Greg Olsen in some hot water the other night because he's speaking up on something and he's not on the field. So don't assume that Justin Jefferson is distraught, majorly frustrated, he wants out of Minnesota, don't do that.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson's experience with the quarterback carousel in the NFL
quotes.excerpt: I played with like 18, 19 different quarterbacks and I had to deal with that.
quotes.quote: No matter what quarterback is playing, I played with like 18, 19 different quarterbacks and I had to deal with that. No matter who was at quarterback, one year in 99, it was 99, I played with four different quarterbacks that season and still made it to the Pro Bowl and ripped it up. So you can't get caught up in what the naysayers is out there saying. You got to do your part.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kirk Cousins is an upgrade for the Vikings' offense
quotes.excerpt: He's better than Carson Wentz. He's better than Kyler Murray. Like literally right now he's better than both.
quotes.quote: He's going to get a ball to the other team a couple times, but I he's better than Carson Wentz. He's better than Kyler Murray. Like literally right now he's better than both of them. So I would be like, yeah, for sure.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Minnesota's past trade for Sam Bradford as a cautionary tale
quotes.excerpt: Remember Minnesota did this several years ago when they went out and acquired Sam Bradford.
quotes.quote: Remember Minnesota did this several years ago when they went out and acquired Sam Bradford because he was on Philadelphia, and I don't remember exactly the quarterback that got hurt, but somebody got hurt in training camp, like right before training camp or opening day, and they gave up a first-round pick to get Sam Bradford. And I don't know how the year worked out for them, but that pick so went a long ways for Philadelphia.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Reflecting on the 2000 NFC Championship game against the Rams
quotes.excerpt: They went out and got Bert Emanuel and Bert Emanuel had a bad catch or something.
quotes.quote: The year before, Tampa Bay played the Rams in the NFC Championship game. They went out and got Bert Emanuel and Bert Emanuel had a bad catch or something in the game. So whatever at the end of the day they didn't advance to the Super Bowl. They traded for me to come to the game to do exactly what I did.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Team excitement after Keyshawn Johnson's first touchdown
quotes.excerpt: The entire team was so excited. If there's 53 people, 47 of them ran to me.
quotes.quote: The entire team was so excited. If there's 53 people, 47 of them ran to me in the end zone. And it made it look, because they were so frustrated they wouldn't give me the ball. When they finally gave me the ball, everybody on the team was crazy.

quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the Rams' defense and playoff chances
quotes.excerpt: It's San Francisco's to lose. And then that two spot, it's going to come down to Seattle.
quotes.quote: It's San Francisco's to lose. And then that two spot, it's going to come down to Seattle and the Rams. Right now, I'm a favor Seattle over the Rams just because their offense is decimated at the receiver position. Myles Garrett obviously helps the situation. Aaron Donald, Myles Garrett, they get Davon Godchaux back, who felt to me like he hadn't played at all this year. So when you start to put their defense together, I don't know if this defense is strong enough to carry them.
